documentation.content:
The **agent worker found and cleaned >3 stuck agent runs**. Multiple agent runs were left in `running` state for >60 minutes before cleanup.

This usually means `run_event_driven_monitor()` or another agent crashed without calling `finish_agent_run()`. The cleanup auto-resolves it, but repeated occurrences indicate a systemic crash.

Investigate:
```
# Check health endpoint
curl -s https://investor-tools-app-gq4yi3pgoa-ew.a.run.app/api/health/data-integrity | python3 -m json.tool

# Force cleanup of any remaining stuck runs
curl -X POST https://investor-tools-app-gq4yi3pgoa-ew.a.run.app/api/agent/runs/cleanup-stuck

# Check agent worker logs
gcloud run jobs executions list --job=investor-tools-worker-job --region=europe-west1
```
